title: Get account
description: Fetch a single Customer Analytics account by id. Returns the full account including typed `properties` (stripe_customer_id, hubspot_deal_id, billing_id, sfdc_id, zendesk_id external identifiers), `tags`, `churned_at` (null if the account has not churned), and `ignored_at` (null if tracked). User assignments (CSM, account executive, ...) live on account relationships — see `accounts-relationships-list`. These are the built-in fields only; a team's own typed attributes are custom properties and are not returned here. Call `custom-property-definitions-list` to see what the team tracks, then `accounts-custom-property-values-list` for this account's values. To link a user to this account rather than the bare list, deep-link it with the path `/customer_analytics/accounts/<id>/<tab>` (using the account `id`; tab is optional — one of notes/users/usage/spend, e.g. `/customer_analytics/accounts/<id>/usage`).
